name: RolesPermissions
harvested_from: laravel-vue-template (built generic 2026-08-24; 17 of 44 local client repos ship some form of RBAC)
description: Role and permission access control over spatie/laravel-permission, wired to the authorization surface the template kernel already ships: the Authorization route middleware, $auth.hasPermission, and route meta permissions_all / permissions_any / roles. Adds role CRUD with a permission matrix UI, a HasAccessControl trait for User, and the permission / role route middleware aliases.
